content:
You can export the contents of a log type to a comma-separated value (CSV) formatted report. By
default, the report contains up to 2,000 rows of log entries.
PAN-OS® Administrator’s Guide 10.0 (EoL)
528
©2025 Palo Alto Networks, Inc.
Monitoring
STEP 1 |
Set the number of rows to display in the report.
1.
Select Device > Setup > Management, then edit the Logging and Reporting Settings.
2.
Click the Log Export and Reporting tab.
3.
Edit the number of Max Rows in CSV Export (up to 1048576 rows).
4.
Click OK.
STEP 2 |
Download the log.
1.
Click Export to CSV (
). A progress bar showing the status of the download appears.
2.
When the download is complete, click Download file to save a copy of the log to your
local folder. For descriptions of the column headers in a downloaded log, refer to Syslog
Field Descriptions.
Next Step...
Schedule Log Exports to an SCP or FTP Server.
